title: Pruna video gets explicit resolution choices
summary:
Pruna video gained explicit resolution models, while Wan-pro and Klein image routing got repairs.

Pruna image and video models were routed through Replicate. Video generation now has separate `p-video-720p` and `p-video-1080p` models, with the API docs updated to match. The `p-video` and `pruna-video` aliases select 720p even if a request asks for a height of 1080 or more; use `p-video-1080p` explicitly for that resolution. Image edits now require an input image, and provider errors are returned more accurately.

Fixed `wan-pro` image-to-video requests that failed because the start image was sent in a format the provider did not accept. `wan-fast` keeps its existing request format.

Updated Klein 4B image-request routing to a replacement GPU endpoint, alongside the fallback route.

highlights.title: Choose Pruna video resolution
highlights.text: Generate Pruna video with `p-video-720p` or select `p-video-1080p` explicitly for 1080p. The `p-video` and `pruna-video` aliases select 720p, even when you request a height of 1080 or more. [See p-video-1080p](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=p-video-1080p).
